run_densepose_dump: run the DensePose model on input images and dump prediction results to a pickle file
run_densepose_show: run the DensePose model on input images and visualize results as contour or segmentation output images
review_InferenceAction: review the InferenceAction class that loads config and model then runs DefaultPredictor on input images
review_register_action: review the register_action decorator that auto-registers action classes into the action registry dictionary
review_ShowAction_visualizers: review the ShowAction VISUALIZERS dict that maps visualization types like dp_contour and dp_segm to visualizer classes
